profiles.name: Viridis Quantity Takeoff

profiles.name: Viridis GHG Ledger
profiles.description: Deterministic Scope 1, 2, and 3 greenhouse-gas inventory with pinned factor packs; pairs with quantity takeoff upstream and disclosure compilation downstream.

profiles.name: Viridis Disclosure Compiler

representative_queries: compile an IFRS S2 climate disclosure

profiles.name: Viridis Tax Credit Engine
profiles.description: Auditable clean-energy tax-credit scenarios for 45Q, 45V, 45Y, 48E, and 45X; pairs with Viridis GHG inventory and compliance evidence.

profiles.name: Viridis Regulatory Radar
profiles.description: Regulatory horizon scan across an energy and climate compliance database; the scan step paired with Viridis carbon accounting, disclosure, and tax-credit agents.
representative_queries: what climate regulations apply to this company

profiles.name: EnergyAI
profiles.description: EnergyAI v1.0 gives agents eight no-key energy discovery tools plus a real commercial activation path. Check incentives, estimate solar production, score an Energy Node, find publicly-rated local installers with explicit non-endorsement disclosures, or create a tracked quote handoff with get_quote_link. Builder Activation starts with bootstrap_energy_project: three commercial calls without a card, then $19/month with $20 in monthly tool credit. Authenticated referring agents retain signed attribution and can earn a 20% bounty when an installer buys a resulting lead.
representative_queries: activate an agent's first commercial energy workflow
what clean energy incentives apply to this home
estimate solar production for a homeowner
find publicly-rated clean-energy installers near a US ZIP code
get a homeowner a link to request installer quotes

profiles.name: Viridis Security Injection Detector
profiles.description: Agent-native prompt and tool-injection screening with explicit verdicts, matched patterns, recommended actions, and trace tool-policy checks. The public MCP supports unauthenticated discovery; tool calls require a Viridis Security API key. Free tier: 1,000 detections/month at mcp.viridis-security.com/signup.
representative_queries: screen untrusted text for prompt injection before my agent reads it
detect whether an agent trace violated the allowed tool policy
add an MCP security guardrail to an autonomous agent
